name: Flower Dome
description: Experience the world's largest column-free conservatory, showcasing plants and flowers from cool-dry regions around the globe.

name: Cloud Forest
description: Discover a misty, mountainous cloud forest ecosystem with the iconic 40-meter tall Supertree-framed waterfall.

name: Floral Fantasy
description: Enjoy seasonal flower displays showcasing botanical arrangements and creative floral installations.

name: Supertree Grove
description: Visit the iconic towering Supertrees, 25-50 meters tall, featuring vertical gardens and nightly light shows.

name: OCBC Skyway
description: Experience a 22-meter elevated walkway connecting two Supertrees with panoramic views of the gardens.

name: Supertree Observatory
description: Ascend to the top of a Supertree for breathtaking 360-degree views of Marina Bay and Singapore.

name: The Canyon
description: Explore a multi-level terraced garden featuring the Heritage Collection with rare and endangered plants.

name: Far East Organization Children's Garden
description: A play garden designed for children with interactive plant-based experiences and water features.

name: Golden Garden
description: A garden featuring golden-hued plants and flowers creating a warm, welcoming aesthetic.

name: Floral Clock
description: A living floral display arranged in the shape of a clock, a unique horticultural artwork.

name: Web of Life
description: Discover the interconnected relationships between plants and the environment in this thematic garden.

name: World of Plants
description: Explore diverse plant species and their habitats from different regions across the globe.

name: Indian Garden
description: A heritage garden showcasing traditional Indian garden design and culturally significant plants.

name: Chinese Garden
description: A traditional Chinese garden with pavilions, bridges, and plants symbolizing harmony and prosperity.

name: Malay Garden
description: A heritage garden reflecting traditional Malay garden design principles and cultural plant uses.

name: Colonial Garden
description: Experience colonial-era garden design with historic plant collections and formal landscaping.

name: Serene Garden
description: A peaceful retreat garden designed for meditation and contemplation with water features.

name: Sun Pavilion
description: An open-air pavilion featuring sun-loving plants and providing scenic viewpoints.

name: Silver Garden
description: A garden showcasing silver and grey-foliaged plants creating an ethereal, luminous atmosphere.

name: Kingfisher Wetlands
description: A wetland garden supporting diverse bird species and aquatic plants in a naturalistic setting.

name: Active Garden
description: An interactive garden featuring educational displays about sustainable gardening practices.

name: The Meadow
description: An open field displaying seasonal wildflower and grass plantings in a natural landscape style.
